notes: §10.3.3: "**Multi-line value form:** after `let x =`, `var x =`, an assignment or `return`, `if_form` and `match_form` are expressions. Each arm yields its **last expression**, and all arms must have the same type. `if` without `else` is not allowed there (K0731)." §10.3.2: "**Inline:** `if c: a else: b` is an expression anywhere". Positive twin.
